cues.en: Instructor: This unsupervised learning challenge is going to be super interesting.
cues.zh: 講師：這個「非監督式學習」挑戰會非常有趣。

cues.en: I hope you find this really insightful about the marvel of the central limit theorem.
cues.zh: 希望能讓你更深入體會中央極限定理的神奇。

cues.en: So what we are going to do is take two uniformly distributed sets of numbers and average them together, and you'll see that their distribution starts
cues.zh: 我們會取兩組均勻分布數字，兩兩平均，你會看到它們的分布開始

cues.en: to look like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 變得像高斯。

cues.en: I think, even more, it's an even simpler exploration of the central limit theorem than what we did in the previous video.
cues.zh: 我認為，這甚至比前一部影片更簡單地探索中央極限定理。

cues.en: So here's the goal, you want to create a distribution of all, so a histogram of all possible averages between two
cues.zh: 目標是，建立所有可能平均值的分布，也就是直方圖，其中兩個

cues.en: uniformly distributed integers that vary from one to 100.
cues.zh: 均勻分布整數都介於 1 和 100。

cues.en: So what does this mean?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, imagine we take two numbers that are drawn from this uniform distribution and we compute their average.
cues.zh: 想像從這個均勻分布取兩個數字，計算平均。

cues.en: So, you know, one of them could be one and one, so one plus one divided by two.
cues.zh: 例如，可以是 1 和 1，也就是 (1+1)/2。

cues.en: That's the average of one and one.
cues.zh: 這是 1 和 1 的平均。

cues.en: Well, that's not the only way that we can take the average between two integers that are uniformly distributed between one and a hundred.
cues.zh: 但這不是兩個介於 1 和 100 的均勻分布整數，唯一的平均組合。

cues.en: We can say one plus two divided by two, and we can do one and three and and you know, so on.
cues.zh: 可以算 (1+2)/2，也可以 1 和 3，依此類推。

cues.en: Eventually we get up to here and then we have to cycle back to have this be two plus one and then two plus two, two plus three, and so on.
cues.zh: 最後到這裡，再繞回 2 加 1、2 加 2、2 加 3，依此類推。

cues.en: And then this is gonna get up to a hundred, and then we cycle to three plus one.
cues.zh: 這個到 100 後，再繞回 3 加 1。

cues.en: So you can see we are taking all the integers between one and a hundred, and they're all equally likely to occur.
cues.zh: 所以取 1 到 100 之間的所有整數，它們出現的可能性完全相同。

cues.en: So they have a uniform distribution, so we have one distribution of integers and then another distribution of integers.
cues.zh: 因此具有均勻分布，一組整數分布，再加另一組整數分布。

cues.en: And they're all from these integers going from one to a hundred.
cues.zh: 全部都來自 1 到 100 這些整數。

cues.en: We come up with all the possible ways of averaging them together, and then that's going to give you a really large number of averages and then make a histogram of those averages,
cues.zh: 列出所有可能的兩兩平均方式，就會得到大量平均值，再把它們畫成直方圖，

cues.en: and you'll be interested to see what the shape of that distribution looks like.
cues.zh: 你會很想知道，分布的形狀是什麼。

cues.en: If you get a really cool answer, then feel free to post it to the q and a forum.
cues.zh: 如果得到很酷的答案，歡迎貼到問答討論區。
